Does the DXIL validator reject SV_ShadingRate in the four
disputed signature positions when it is asked on its own?

Each case compiles with -Vd (validation disabled at compile
time, so a container is produced either way) and then hands the
container to dxv.exe.  dxv prints nothing and exits 0 when the
module validates.  Silence is only readable next to a control
that shows dxv would speak: control-valfail.hlsl is the same
pipeline with a root signature that does not cover its SRV, and
it goes through the identical two steps.

dxv links the same lib/DxilValidation that dxc calls inline, so
this is a cross-check against a harness artefact, NOT a second
independent implementation.
# dxc: <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe
# dxv: <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxv.exe

--- repro: vs_6_4 VSMain (repro.hlsl) ---

$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T vs_6_4 -E VSMain -Vd -Fo <repo>/.github/skills/dxc-issue-triage/data/issues/3872/dxv-out/repro-VSMain.dxbc repro.hlsl
# exit: 0 (0x00000000)

$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxv.exe <repo>/.github/skills/dxc-issue-triage/data/issues/3872/dxv-out/repro-VSMain.dxbc
# exit: 0 (0x00000000)
Validation succeeded.
--- repro: hs_6_4 HSCPInMain (repro.hlsl) ---

$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T hs_6_4 -E HSCPInMain -Vd -Fo <repo>/.github/skills/dxc-issue-triage/data/issues/3872/dxv-out/repro-HSCPInMain.dxbc repro.hlsl
# exit: 0 (0x00000000)

# exit: 0 (0x00000000)
Validation succeeded.

--- control: vs_6_4 VSMain (control-valfail.hlsl) ---

$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T vs_6_4 -E VSMain -Vd -Fo <repo>/.github/skills/dxc-issue-triage/data/issues/3872/dxv-out/control-valfail-VSMain.dxbc control-valfail.hlsl
# exit: 0 (0x00000000)

# exit: 1 (0x00000001)
error: Root Signature in DXIL container is not compatible with shader.
error: Shader SRV descriptor range (RegisterSpace=0, NumDescriptors=1, BaseShaderRegister=3) is not fully bound in root signature.

Validation failed.

Read the control rows first: if they do not say 'dxv rejected', the repro rows say nothing.
